title: Find a tutor

filters.heading: Filters
filters.subject: Subject
filters.budgetHint: Rupees per hour, compared on the normalised rate.
filters.verifiedOnly: Only tutors with a passed subject assessment
filters.verifiedOnlyHint: Every tutor here is identity-verified. This narrows further, to those who have passed a topic assessment.
filters.volunteerOnlyHint: Volunteers teach without a fee and are verified to exactly the same standard.

empty.title: No tutors match yet
empty.body: Nothing matches every filter you have set. Widening one of them usually helps.
empty.bodyFemaleOnly: No female tutor currently matches this search. This happens in areas where few female tutors have registered — it is the gap this platform exists to close, and there are two things worth doing about it.
empty.widenBody_one: There is {{count}} area next to yours that families here usually consider close enough.
empty.widenBody_other: There are {{count}} areas next to yours that families here usually consider close enough.
empty.widenNoneBody: No neighbouring areas are recorded for this one yet.
empty.demandBody: Tutors read the demand board, and it is how we learn where supply is short. It will not help you today, but it is the only thing that changes what is here in a month.
empty.demandPrivacy: The record holds what you searched for — subject, level, area — and nothing about you. No name, no contact, no account link.
empty.demandPosted: Posted. Tutors looking for work in this area will see it.
empty.otherBudget: Raise or remove the hourly ceiling.
empty.otherTopics: Search the whole subject instead of specific topics.
empty.otherMode: Allow online as well as home visits.
empty.otherVerified: Include tutors whose subject assessment is still pending.
empty.otherAvailability: Widen the day or time you asked for.

genderNote: Tutors who do not match your gender preference are not shown at all — they are excluded, not ranked lower.

picker.areaIsFinest: Area is as precise as this platform gets. There is no map and no pin — a tutor sees the area before she confirms, and the street address only after.
picker.adjacentHint: Adds areas a family would consider near enough — a curated list, not a distance.
picker.noAdjacent: No neighbouring areas are recorded for this one.
picker.boardMatters: A Sindh Board tutor and a Cambridge tutor are not interchangeable. Choose the board your child actually sits.
picker.topicsHint: Choose the ones that matter. Leave it empty to search the whole subject.
picker.topicsNeedTriple: Choose a subject, level and board to see topics.
picker.noTopics: No topics are recorded for this combination yet.

prereq.explanation: Each topic rests on the ones beneath it. A student who is struggling near the bottom of a chain will keep struggling with everything above it, however much of the top is practised.
prereq.emptyBody: Select a topic to see what it depends on.
prereq.noneBody: This topic does not depend on anything else in the syllabus, or the chain has not been mapped for this board yet.

restriction.femaleBody: Every tutor who is not female has been excluded from these results by the server. None appears further down the list, and none is hidden behind a filter you could switch off by accident.
restriction.maleBody: Every tutor who is not male has been excluded from these results by the server. None appears further down the list.
restriction.enforcedNote: This is an exclusion, not an ordering. The results below are the complete set that matches.
restriction.countNote_one: {{count}} tutor matches everything you asked for.
restriction.countNote_other: {{count}} tutors match everything you asked for.

benchmark.title: Local rates
benchmark.note: Compared on an hourly basis, so monthly and per-session rates sit on the same scale.
benchmark.suppressed: Not enough tutors in this area and subject to publish a reliable local rate. We would rather show nothing than a figure drawn from two or three people.

card.trayFull: Comparison is full at {{max}}. Remove one to add another.

compare.caption: Tutors compared side by side
compare.overlapNone: They share no weekly slot. You would need a different time with each.
compare.emptyBody: Add up to {{max}} tutors from the results and see them side by side.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.confirmationExplain: How often she accepts a booking request that matches what she offers.
reliability.onTimeExplain: How often sessions started at the agreed time, from family reports.
reliability.completionExplain: How often an arrangement ran to its agreed end rather than stopping early.
reliability.tooFewSessions: Not enough completed engagements yet to show reliable figures. Below {{count}} the percentages say more about the small number than about the tutor.
reliability.safetyExclusion: Declines she makes under her own declared safety conditions are excluded from these figures. A tutor is never penalised for holding to the conditions she set.

reviews.lowSignalExplain: This review says little about what actually happened, so it counts for less in ranking. It is shown in full because the person meant it.
reviews.lowSignalNote_one: One review carries little detail and is marked. It is shown, not hidden.
reviews.lowSignalNote_other: {{count}} reviews carry little detail and are marked. They are shown, not hidden.
reviews.contradictionExplain: The star rating and the written review point in different directions. Both are shown exactly as the reviewer left them — we have not changed the rating.
reviews.basisNote: Every review here comes from a family that completed a booking with this tutor.
reviews.showBreakdown: Show what the review says, dimension by dimension
reviews.notAnalysed: This review has not been analysed. It is shown as written.
reviews.emptyBody: A review can only be left by a family that completed a booking, so a new tutor has none.
reviews.noCompetencyYet: No topic assessments have been taken yet.

ranking.title: How this position was calculated
ranking.deterministicNote: This explains a calculation, not an opinion. The same search always produces the same order, and every figure below comes from stored data.
ranking.narrationUnavailable: The written explanation is unavailable at the moment. The calculation itself is below and is unaffected.
ranking.breakdownNote: Ustaad.com never introduces a number into the explanation that is not in this table.

factor.heading: Factor
factor.topicCoverage: Assessed on the topics you searched for

share.title: Share this profile
share.message: Have a look at {{name}} on Ustaad.com — her identity has been verified by the platform.
share.note: Anyone with this link can see the profile. Nothing private is shared.
share.qrFailed: The code could not be drawn. The link below still works.

booking.title: Book a session
booking.paymentNote: Ustaad.com records what you agree. It does not take the payment — that is between you and the tutor.

single.title: One session
single.body: One hour on a specific topic, at a time you both agree.
single.for: For a chapter that is not going in, or the week before an exam.

package.title: A short package
package.body: A set number of sessions over a few weeks, agreed in advance.
package.for: For exam preparation, or a term that has gone off track.

monthly.title: Monthly
monthly.body: A regular weekly arrangement, billed by the month.
monthly.for: For steady work through a school year.

profile.areaOnlyNote: Public profiles show the area only. A tutor sees an exact address after she confirms a booking, and nobody else ever does.
